rachel: Quick q — Kayla (new hire, start 2026-04-15) emailed a scanned passport as ID. Can we complete I-9 remotely or does she need to bring the physical passport on Day 1? Also need to move her Day 1 orientation from 10:00 → 14:00 (client conflict). Any issues with escort/badge?

alex: We generally need to physically inspect original docs for Form I-9. For remote hires we use the alternative verification paths: authorized agent/notary inspection or in-person verification within 3 business days. If Kayla can get a notary or an authorized agent to inspect, that satisfies Section 2. Otherwise she must present originals within 3 business days. See people-ops handbook for exceptions.

jen: I'll check with Kayla about a notary. If she can’t do that, can we set her Day 1 as remote onboarding and require an in-person visit by EOD Fri? Also, 14:00 works for orientation from our side. @sanjay can you reserve a room and arrange a temp badge if needed?

sanjay: Reserving Conf A for 14:00. Temp badge is fine — limited access only until ID cleared (no infra access). Front desk check-in code: `ONB-1916`. Badge pickup window 09:00–17:00. I'll schedule an escort for 14:00.

people-ops-bot: New hire intake recorded for Kayla. Required docs checklist: passport (original), SSN card if applicable. I-9 Section 2 deadline = 3 business days after start. Lookup: https://redwood.internal/people/i9-checklist (internal).

rachel: Perfect. Jen — can you confirm with Kayla whether she can get a notary or prefers remote Day 1? If remote, send Zoom link + limited access instructions. If in-person, remind her to bring originals and plan for the escort. Closing loop pls :thumbsup:

jen: Pinged Kayla — she can visit a notary on Thursday morning. I'll update intake and set orientation to 14:00. Thanks everyone!
